summary: Reads Panel Values from Panel Components into CHOP channels. Common bridge from UI widgets to control signals; panel values can also be accessed through the panel member of the PanelCOMP Class.

key_params.name: component
key_params.note: Path of the Panel Component being referenced.

key_params.name: select
key_params.note: Panel values to create channels for; use * for all values or select individual values from the menu.

key_params.name: rename
key_params.note: Optional replacement channel names for selected panel values.

key_params.name: queue
key_params.note: Queue overlapping events that occur in one time slice so instant values like wheel or key are not collapsed to only the last value.

key_params.name: queuesize
key_params.note: Maximum event queue size; earlier events are discarded when more events arrive than the queue can hold.

key_params.name: timeslice
key_params.note: Common CHOP option to force channels to be time sliced.

key_params.name: scope
key_params.note: Common CHOP scope string restricting affected channels.

common_gotchas: Panel CHOP references panel components through the Component parameter; it does not wire to them like ordinary data-flow nodes.
Some panel values such as wheel and key are instantaneous, switching between a value and 0 in the same time slice.
When Queue Overlapping Events is off, only the last value in the time slice is used, so fast instantaneous changes can be missed.
Queue Size limits how many queued events are retained; if more events arrive than the Queue Size, earlier events are discarded.
Make sure UI widgets are in a visible/active panel if user interaction is expected.
